methods.name: Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder (CPA)
methods.protocol_description: CPA combines interpretable linear models with deep learning. It learns factorized latent representations of perturbations and covariates using an adversarial loss to ensure independence. At prediction time, embeddings are recombined to predict effects of novel perturbation-covariate combinations.

methods.name: chemCPA
methods.protocol_description: Extension of CPA that incorporates chemical descriptors of drugs via a pre-trained molecule encoder, perturbation encoder, and amortized dosage scaler, enabling prediction for unseen drugs.
